summary: Temporary drone danger area EGD294H around North Lynn, Kings Lynn, 1.6 nautical miles radius, surface to 500 feet above sea level, 0700-2300 daily.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD294H INSTALLED WI 1.6NM RADIUS OF
524606N 0002408E (NORTH LYNN, KINGS LYNN). BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF
SIGHT (BVLOS) UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE TDA. MAX HGT 400FT
AGL. EMERG SERVICES ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN ACCORDANCE WITH
LOCAL DECONFLICTION AGREEMENTS. OPEN AND SPECIFIC CAT VISUAL LINE
OF SIGHT (VLOS) UAS OPS ARE PERMITTED WI THE TDA WITHOUT PRIOR
APPROVAL OR DECONFLICTION. OTHER NON-STANDARD FLIGHT, FLIGHT 
RESTRICTION ZONE OR CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS MUST BE OBTAINED. 
OPERATORS ARE REMINDED OF THEIR RESPONSIBILITY UNDER CAP722 5.2.2.3 
REGARDING OPR IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG RESPONSE EFFORT. FOR 
INFO AROPS(AT)CAA.CO.UK. DEC 24-JAN 03 CTC 
DRONEFIRSTRESPONDER(AT)NORFOLK.POLICE.UK. AR-2026-8329/04.
